description.text: This program is designed to turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in international economy and trade, familiar with the latest developments in the field of international trade of the modern world, able to handle international business and economic cooperation, and qualified for careers in business, management, research, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations. Major Courses: Political Economics, Western Economics, International Economics, Econometrics, Introduction to World Economy, International Trade Theory and Practice, International Finance, International Settlement, Monetary Banking, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, etc. Degree Awarded: Bachelor's Degree in Economics

duration.text: The International Economy and Trade at Central South University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK For Chinese-meidum programs. 2.Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 3.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 4.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 5.High school academic transcript 6.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 7.English proficiency test certificate If any, for English-medium programs; For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English

requirements.text: Qualification 1. Applicants with an educational background equal to high school graducation in China 2. Band III certificate in HSK (Examination on Chinese language level), or have studied Chinese for more than one year.
